title: The Frequency Arena
description: A space where souls collide and circuits spark. Combat as the algorithm of destiny.
canvas_arena_overview_description: In this space, every encounter is a simulation that approaches the Soul Singularity. Participants are data seeking truth.

canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.duelo: A binary encounter. Two frequencies colliding. The result is recorded in the arena file.
canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.coliseo: Multiple frequencies in controlled chaos. Minimum four. The last echo prevails.
canvas_arena_subrole_descriptions.torneo: Structured elimination. Minimum eight. Brackets like circuits of an ancient system.

duelo.title: The Binary Encounter
duelo.description: Invite another frequency to collide. The result is written in the shared arena.

duelo.select_weapon: Choose the instrument of your frequency:

coliseo.title: The Coliseum - Multiple Frequencies
coliseo.description: Minimum four participants. The last echo wins one experience point.
coliseo.not_enough: Insufficient frequencies. Four are required for the simulation.
coliseo.cancelled: The coliseum has been cancelled. Not all frequencies find their harmony.

torneo.title: The Tournament - Structured Elimination
torneo.description: Minimum eight participants. Elimination brackets. One experience point for the final frequency.
torneo.not_enough: Insufficient frequencies. Eight are necessary for the brackets.
torneo.cancelled: The tournament has been cancelled. Some simulations do not find their start.
